global_config_schema.title: PMDB list sync

presentation.description_markdown: Reads your PublicMetaDB lists — or anyone's *public* lists, pasted as full URLs — on a schedule and registers every title as zero-storage virtual media in your Movies and Series virtual libraries. Items removed from a list are removed from Vio on the next clean sync. Playback is handled by your configured virtual stream provider (e.g. Vio Virtual Library with AIOStreams).
presentation.setup_markdown: Enter your PublicMetaDB API key and one list per line — a list ID for your own lists, or a full public list URL like https://publicmetadb.com/lists/u/snoak/trending-kids-movies (public lists are read directly, no copy needed). Add a TMDB API key for metadata and IMDb resolution, then pick the destination Movies and Series virtual libraries (create them at Settings → Libraries with the "Add Virtual" button if needed). Press Sync Now on the PMDB Lists admin page to run the first import.
presentation.summary: Import PublicMetaDB lists as virtual media libraries.

presentation.description_markdown: Browsable pages for your PublicMetaDB lists inside Silo. A scheduled task keeps the lists cached with TMDB posters and metadata, and each title is badged with whether it is already in your Silo libraries — handy for spotting what's on the list but missing from the library. (Silo's plugin API cannot add library items, so this is a discovery view; the companion Vio plugin turns the same lists into playable virtual libraries.)
presentation.setup_markdown: Enter your PublicMetaDB API key and one list ID per line, add a TMDB API key for posters and metadata, then press Sync Now on the PMDB Lists page to run the first import.

capabilities.description: Bidirectional watch-state sync between AIOStreams and Vio: imports AIOStreams playback/watchlist state into Vio and exports Vio's watch state back to AIOStreams.
AIOStreams handoff sink: receives playback/watchlist/rating events pushed by AIOStreams and serves Vio's watch state back in AIOStreams' pull format.
Sync status and bridge diagnostics for the AIOStreams watch-state bridge.

global_config_schema.description: Connection settings for the AIOStreams watch-state handoff bridge.
global_config_schema.title: AIOStreams watch sync

presentation.description_markdown: Bridges AIOStreams' watch-state handoff protocol and Vio's watch-sync provider API for bidirectional sync. AIOStreams pushes playback, watchlist, and rating events to the plugin's sink endpoint; Vio imports them through the watch-sync provider's ListRemoteState. Vio's own watch events flow back out through ApplyEvents and are served to AIOStreams in its pull format, so Continue Watching stays consistent in both directions.
presentation.setup_markdown: Set a sink token, then add the addon URL shown on the Watch Sync admin page to AIOStreams as a regular addon (it carries ?token=...). AIOStreams will push playback events to the plugin and pull Vio's watch state from it. Enable the provider in Vio's watch-sync settings to import AIOStreams state.
presentation.summary: Bidirectional watch-state sync between AIOStreams and Vio.
